Details 
 This western shirt is crafted from yarn dyed 100% cotton dobby and features an exclusive sand plaid with satin stitch. It has a one-point ultra-deep curved back yoke, logo pearl snap front, contrasting chambray inside trim, and three snap cuffs. The front left pocket is embroidered with the Stetson "S" logo and the right sleeve placket is embroidered with "STETSON.” Garment washed for softness, it has the feel of an old favorite that will only get better with time. Cut trim for a modern fit.
